title: Best Air Fryer Under ₹8,000 in India (2026): 5 Picks Beyond Preset Hype
description: Compare the best air fryers under ₹8,000 in India by wattage, basket size, cooking consistency and service—plus the oversized model to skip.
short_desc: Reliable basket fryers and one versatile oven, ranked by real cooking fundamentals.

headings.text: What actually matters in an air fryer under ₹8,000

cta.headline: Match the basket to your household
cta.sub: A 4L fryer is quick for couples; 5.5L or larger reduces batch cooking for families.

faq.q: Which is the best air fryer under ₹8,000 in India?
faq.a: The Philips HD9252/90 is the safest all-round pick for even cooking and service. The Instant Vortex 4L is better when faster 1600W heating and digital controls matter.

faq.q: Is 4L enough for a family of four?
faq.a: It is workable for snacks but usually requires two batches for a complete family meal. A 5.5-6L basket is more convenient for four adults.

faq.q: Air fryer or air-fryer oven: which is better?
faq.a: A basket fryer is faster and usually crisps better. An oven-style 10-12L model holds more and can toast or rotisserie, but needs more counter space and cleaning.

faq.q: Do air fryers really use 90% less oil?
faq.a: Oil reduction depends on the dish. Frozen snacks may need no added oil, while fresh pakoras still need a light coating. Treat 90% as a best-case marketing claim.
One year is common; Philips and some Indian brands may offer two years on selected models. Verify the exact model and seller invoice.
